description:
About Multi Media, LLC
 Multi Media, LLC is a global technology company operating a high-traffic live-streaming platform used by millions of people around the world. Behind the experience is a team solving challenging problems in real-time video, scalability, reliability, data, machine learning, and user experience.
 We’re a place for people who want their work to matter. Our teams have the autonomy to make decisions, the opportunity to work on problems at meaningful scale, and the ability to see their work shape experiences for a global audience in real time. We value curiosity, ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
 The Role
 We are looking for a frontend-leaning Software Engineer to join our Viewer team and help build user-facing features that reach millions of people worldwide.
 You'll primarily work with React and JavaScript/TypeScript, collaborating closely with product, design, QA, and other engineers to deliver meaningful improvements to the user experience. We're looking for someone who enjoys solving problems beyond writing code, understands the value of the features they're building, and is excited to leverage modern development tools, including AI, to work more effectively.
 This is a great opportunity for an early-career engineer who is eager to grow their technical skills, take ownership of their work, and contribute to the broader product development process.
 What You’ll Do
 Design, develop, and maintain user-facing features using React, JavaScript/TypeScript, and Python
 Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code
 Collaborate with engineers, product managers, designers, and QA to build and improve features
 Participate in code reviews, debugging, and troubleshooting
 Contribute to technical discussions and help identify solutions to engineering challenges
 Work with experienced engineers to learn best practices and grow your technical skills
 Take ownership of assigned tasks and see features through development, testing, and deployment
 Help improve the performance, reliability, and overall user experience of our platform
 Requirements 
 You Have
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
 Foundational experience in web development
 Experience writing production code in JavaScript/TypeScript and/or Python
 Experience working with React in a professional or substantial project setting
 Familiarity with backend frameworks such as Django, Flask, or similar
 Strong debugging, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills
 Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including product, design, and QA
 Ownership mindset and ability to manage tasks through completion with guidance
 Interest in understanding user needs and the impact of your work on the product
 Curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies, including AI-assisted development tools
 Collaborative, adaptable, and open to feedback
 
 Bonus Points
 Experience shipping full-stack features end-to-end
 Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants to improve development workflows
 Experience working with QA teams, writing tests, or improving software quality
 Experience with AWS or GCP
 Experience working on high-traffic applications
 Benefits 
 What You’ll Get
 Fair and competitive base salary
 Fully Remote Optional
 Health, Vision, Dental, and Life Insurances for you and any dependents, with policy premiums covered by the Company
 Long & Short term disability insurance
 Unlimited PTO 
 Annual Year-End Company Closure
 Optional 401k with 5% matching
 12 Paid Holidays
 Paid Lunches in-office, or if Remote, a $125/week stipend via Sharebite
 EAP and Employee Recognition Programs
 And much more!
 
 The base salary range for this position is $130,000 - $165,000 annually, plus additional compensation and benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum range for a new hire across the U.S. for the posted position. A candidate's specific pay will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the candidate's job-related skills, relevant education, training, experience, certifications, and abilities, as well as other factors unique to each candidate.
 Multi Media, LLC, is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
